verse: “Sovereign Lord, as You have promised, You now dismiss Your servant in peace. For my eyes have seen Your salvation,
story: Simeon had waited his whole life in the temple, and one afternoon a young couple walked in with their firstborn.

He takes the child in his arms and speaks as a sentry finally relieved of his watch. The Lord has kept His promise, so Simeon may depart in peace. The reason is not a doctrine but a person: his own eyes have seen God's salvation. A baby brought with the offering of the poor is the rescue Israel has longed for, and an old man is content to go now that he has held it.
Faith waits, sometimes for years. When the waiting is long, remember that God keeps His word on His own good schedule.
